how: We read the website of every Philadelphia wedding photographer listed on Lazo (183 listings, 155 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: an outsourced editing service, a national chain's Philadelphia page, a Nashville photographer with a local listing, and sites that were only a menu or a testimonial. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Have you shot my venue in my season? Philadelphia light swings from long June evenings to 4:30 sunsets in December, and the timeline should follow it.
Is a second photographer included, and how many hours before you start charging extra?
When does the full gallery arrive, and can I see a complete wedding from start to finish rather than a highlights page?

picks.name: Jordan Brian Studios
picks.blurb: Jordan has photographed weddings for 21 years and more than 500 of them, and now takes only 15 a year. Every wedding gets full-day coverage and two photographers, most of them outdoors: South Jersey backyards and gardens, the sand at the Jersey Shore, and Philadelphia rooftops and ballrooms. Based in Mount Laurel.

picks.name: Fuller Photography
picks.blurb: When you reach out to Fuller Photography you are talking to the photographer, the same person who helps you prepare and shows up with the camera. Based in West Grove, Chester County, promising vibrant, candid-first photos, relaxed direction and clear pricing, across Pennsylvania, Delaware, Maryland and New Jersey.

picks.name: Deibert Photography
picks.blurb: Deibert Photography is built for couples who feel awkward in front of a camera: the approach is helping you stay present rather than perform. Wedding collections start at $3,500 with coverage by Ben, and albums, prints and engagement sessions as add-ons.

picks.name: New Pace Weddings
picks.blurb: A boutique Ardmore studio doing photo, video and social content as one team, with a wedding timeline coordinator working alongside the photographer, videographer and editor. New Pace says the point is one crew so you are not juggling vendors, and has been at it since 2007.

picks.name: Days Away Creative
picks.blurb: Days Away Creative shoots natural wedding photography for couples who want the day to feel like them rather than a performance for the camera. The photographer grew up in New Jersey and claims Philadelphia as home, and the site prints wedding collections for Pennsylvania and New Jersey.

picks.name: Pat Furey Photography
picks.blurb: Pat Furey Photography is a luxury Philadelphia studio doing natural, editorial wedding photography since 2008. It is run by Pat, a service-obsessed entrepreneur, and Claire, a non-representational painter, who have worked nearly inseparably since meeting over coffee a decade ago; based in Philadelphia and New York, traveling worldwide.

picks.name: Daniel Fugaciu Photography
picks.blurb: Over 15 years of weddings from a Havertown boutique studio that also does videography and specializes in art prints and custom heirloom albums. Daniel Fugaciu builds each package around the couple's day rather than selling one-size-fits-all coverage.

picks.name: Emily Wren Photography
picks.blurb: Emily Wren studied image-making at the Rhode Island School of Design after a childhood spent with a father who photographed the family constantly. Her Philadelphia studio does wedding photo and video with an heirloom-quality, artistic bent, serving Pennsylvania, New Jersey and New England.

picks.name: Samantha Jay Photography, LLC
picks.blurb: Samantha Jay has documented over 400 couples in nearly a decade of photographing weddings, aiming for heirloom images that live in your home for years. Based in Media, with an effortless wedding and engagement experience for Pennsylvania and Delaware couples.

picks.name: RCC Photography
picks.blurb: Raquel of RCC Photography wants your photos to put you back in the moment the way old family photos do, the soft squeeze before you walk down the aisle included. Timeless, emotional, editorial work across Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, New Jersey and the Main Line, with destination weddings too.

picks.name: Allison McCafferty Photography
picks.blurb: Allison McCafferty photographs South Jersey weddings documentary-style, a mix of candid and posed, going for bright, crisp, colorful images that feel natural. Based in Shamong, serving New Jersey, Pennsylvania and beyond, with collections built so the experience feels easy and stress-free.

picks.name: Duca Studio Photography & Video
picks.blurb: Duca Studio in King of Prussia is three generations of photographers and filmmakers; couples who booked them decades ago now send their children. Every collection includes a custom wedding album and a pre-wedding consultation, and the team serves the Philadelphia area and beyond.
